name: punjab-attendance-payroll-root
description: Punjab Attendance & Payroll - 100% Free Mobile Workforce & Payroll Management

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.android:sync: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: cd frontend && npx cap open android
scripts.android:build: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
